text:
Priya: Heads up 10xRetail evaluating a 6-week on-prem POC in an isolated DC. Constraints: monthly 2hr maintenance windows, USB import only, strict artifact signing, no model-change during POC. They want a runnable SOW, runbook, and security Q&A by Friday. Can eng/sales commit?
Ben: doable but call out limitations. Plan: initial signed USB full bootstrap, then minibundle deltas for updates during 2hr windows. No OS/kernel upgrades in-window.
Sofia: runbook bullets: preflight checksum + env checks, stop services, apply minibundle, verify signatures, warm KV cache, smoke sample queries (3), latency check, rollback automated. Keep steps parallelizable.
Diego: packaging detail  minibundles = tar.gz with manifest.json + delta layers. Target delta <=200MB. If >200MB require extended window. We should avoid shipping quantization changes mid-POC.
Priya: security asks: do we require HSM? customer wants strong chain-of-custody.
Sofia: we can require customer-managed KMS/HSM or an HSM-backed signing process on their side. We'll validate signatures locally. Addendum: customer accepts physical media custody; we provide signed checksum and verification procedure.
Ben: Operational notes: provide two 1-hr dry runs before first window (free). Support coverage: 2x SRE hours included first week; additional oncall billed.
Diego: CI/build note: we can produce detachable signatures (DSA/sha256) and a verification tool. I'll add sample command:
```
redwoodctl verify --bundle /mnt/usb/minidelta.tar.gz --sig /mnt/usb/minidelta.sig
redwoodctl apply --bundle /var/lib/redwood/bundles/minidelta.tar.gz --rollback-on-fail
```
Sofia: questionnaire redlines for Legal: key custody (Q12), artifact signing chain (Q7), export controls (Q29).
LegalBot: flagged Q12 and Q29 for legal review.
BuildBot: minibundle built 1775010200 by ci/minibuilder v3, sig: sha256:deadbeef..., status: signed.
Priya: next steps  Sofia drafts runbook + sample commands, Diego prepares minibundle spec and verify tool, Ben drafts SOW/pricing, Legal to review redlines. Deliverable to customer on Friday. :thumbsup:
